title: VGGT · 多视角几何统一预测架构

description.zh: 适合学习“统一骨干网络 → 多任务几何输出”的信息分层，技术模块紧凑但主线分明。
description.en: An information-dense, author-hosted architecture that groups shared backbone and geometry-specific outputs without losing the central flow.

zh: 需要寻找原创方法图/Teaser 的构图、模块分层和视觉叙事参考。
en: Looking for high-quality visual layout patterns for a scientific teaser or method figure.

zh: 共享主干与任务头采用明确分组；多输出端并置，减少重复箭头；适合信息密度较高的 Method Figure。
en: A visually coherent shared trunk, distinct task heads, and parallel output panels keep a dense method understandable.

zh: 官网 Architecture 图不等于已证实是论文 Figure 1；不能直接标成可编辑的原始矢量文件。
en: Website architecture image is not verified as paper Figure 1 and is not provided here as editable artwork.

alt.zh: VGGT 作者公开的模型结构图：输入图像与相机 token、交替 attention、不同几何输出分支。
alt.en: Author-hosted VGGT model architecture with image/camera tokens, attention blocks, and geometry prediction branches.

insight.zh: 多项 3D 预测任务共用主干，只需一张图就让读者看懂“共享特征—多头输出”的核心结构，而不必分开重画几条管线。
insight.en: One shared backbone communicates several 3D prediction tasks through grouped output heads rather than duplicating whole pipelines.

zh: 共享主干与任务头采用明确分组；多输出端并置，减少重复箭头；适合信息密度较高的 Method Figure。
en: A visually coherent shared trunk, distinct task heads, and parallel output panels keep a dense method understandable.

zh: 借鉴分层与流向，不照搬 VGGT 架构及内容；按自己的张量、模块与任务重新设计标签。
en: Transfer the backbone/head hierarchy, not VGGT's module claims; redraw with your own verified operators and outputs.
